symptoms: Ptosis (drooping eyelids), abdominal colic, respiratory failure, minimal local pain or swelling. Often bites at night while sleeping.
identification: Glossy blue-black body with paired thin white bands; triangular head barely distinct from neck.
first_aid: Immobilise limb, keep patient calm, rush to ASV centre. Do not wait for pain or swelling.

symptoms: Severe local swelling, tissue necrosis, difficulty breathing, bulbar palsy, respiratory paralysis.
identification: Wide hood with a spectacle-shaped mark on the back; raises hood and hisses when threatened.
first_aid: Remove rings and tight items, immobilise, urgent ASV. Watch for breathing difficulty.

symptoms: Continuous bleeding from gums and bite site, acute kidney injury, massive swelling, hypotension.
identification: Heavy body, flat triangular head, three rows of dark brown oval chain-link blotches.
first_aid: Do not apply tourniquet. Immobilise, monitor bleeding, urgent ASV and renal support.

symptoms: Coagulation failure, persistent oozing of blood, internal bleeding, localised oedema.
identification: Small (1–2 ft), rough keeled scales, white trident/cross mark on head; rubs scales to make a sawing sound.
first_aid: Immobilise and transport urgently. 20WBCT at facility; do not cut or suck the wound.

common_name: Non-Venomous (Rat Snake, Blind Snake, Water Snake)
hindi_name: धामिन / अंधा साँप / पानी का साँप
scientific_name: Ptyas mucosa, Indotyphlops spp., Fowlea spp.
symptoms: Abrasions, scratches, psychological shock or hyperventilation without autonomic deregulation.
identification: Uniform dentition marks rather than two fang punctures; species-specific scale patterns.
first_aid: Wash wound, reassure, observe. No ASV indicated unless envenomation signs appear.

symptoms: Any systemic symptom or fang marks must be treated as envenomation until proven otherwise.
identification: Photograph safely from a distance if possible; never handle or kill the snake.
first_aid: Immobilise, observe for 24 hours, perform 20WBCT, and follow institutional ASV protocol.
